summary: The candidate fixes the DSpark context/generation-boundary planner contract in source and passed focused plus independent CPU/GPU boundary cases. Changes are requested because its new registered test violates repository path taxonomy and the candidate report incorrectly claims the registration validator passed.

tests.what_was_measured: On the exact recorded base, seq_len=1048574 plus offsets 0..5 produced four illegal positions: 1048576..1048579.
At the exact candidate commit, all four candidate boundary regressions passed.
CPU and AMD GPU mixed per-request context/generation budgets clamped to [6,3,2,1]; padded draft positions remained below max_context_len; exhausted rows were explicitly rejected.
39 tests and 18 subtests passed across the candidate regression and existing DSpark scheduling/ragged-layout coverage.
The candidate regression path violates registered-test taxonomy because `spec` is not an allowed test kind.
Both changed runtime modules compiled as Python source.

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-ddec5b11e579/raw/candidate_independent_adversarial.txt records execution on one AMD Instinct MI355X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2.26015.
remaining_counterexamples: The candidate's new regression is rejected by scripts/lint/check_registered_tests.py due to its invalid registered-test directory.
No runtime counterexample to the original position-boundary contract was found in the available source-level, CPU, or single-GPU cases.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights were unavailable, so full-model semantic behavior was not exercised.
The reported NVIDIA B300 CUDA 13 TP2 environment was unavailable; the assigned environment had one AMD Instinct MI355X on ROCm 7.2.
The original fused_q_norm_rope CUDA illegal-address crash and distributed TP behavior could not be reproduced directly.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes no native source.
